articles.title: Your most-read stories of 2025
articles.summary: BBC Scotland News has compiled its top 20 most-read stories of 2025, ranked by page views. The list is headlined by a UK Supreme Court ruling, indicating significant public interest in judicial decisions and national legal affairs within Scotland and the wider UK. This retrospective offers insight into the key events and topics that most captivated Scottish audiences throughout the year.

articles.title: From data center spas to servers in space: How the energy crunch is reshaping cloud computing
articles.summary: Lenovo, in partnership with AKT II and Mamou-Mani, is conceptualizing the data centers of the future, envisioning a unique 'data center spa.' This innovative approach is driven by the breakneck speed of artificial intelligence advancements, which necessitates a fundamental rethinking of power management and infrastructure for next-generation computing. The collaboration aims to redefine how data centers function and integrate.
